description.zh: 是否对此次请求进行检索。取值：false，目前仅支持不检索本次请求，直接释放容量预定服务。
description.en: Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Set the value to false. This indicates that the system directly releases the capacity reservation.
The ID of the capacity reservation.

description.zh: 容量预定服务所属地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the capacity reservation. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

descriptions.zh: 立即生效的容量预定服务，当释放方式为手动释放时，调用该接口可直接释放容量预定服务。
descriptions.en: If the release mode of a capacity reservation that takes effect immediately is set to manual release, you can call this operation to release the capacity reservation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs release-capacity-reservation --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --private-pool-options-id crp-bp67acfmxazb40000 --dry-run false --region cn-hangzhou
